newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tests propel Progen shares higher.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tests propel Progen shares higher.

text.p: Shares in biotechnology group Progen Industries Ltd continued to rise on Friday, jumping 23 cents to a record high A$1.15 as enthusiastic investors bought in following promising results from its anti-cancer compound.
On Thursday, the company said trials of its PI-88 compound significantly inhibited the growth rate of human colon cancer in mice which had been transplanted with primary human tumours.
Brokers said that while the company was planning a NASDAQ listing, the activity today was more likely to have been generated by the positive coverage the results had received.

"It got quite a bit of coverage and I think people are just catching up with the news from yesterday," said a Sydney-based dealer. "The NASDAQ listing has been on the cards for a while but it is probably still a way down the track."
Progen shares closed 17 cents higher at A$1.09 on turnover of 872,926 shares.
